text:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] embeddings_route QPS spike detected (us-west-2). Queue depth rising on embedding workers, 95th latency > 8s, error rate creeping. Auto-shed policy kicked in at 21:03 UTC. :rotating_light:

rachel: paging oncall — I'm taking initial lead. Pulling logs and client IDs now.

rachel: quick summary from grafana: sustained ~4x baseline QPS for embeddings_route, two heavy customers (customerA, customerC) account for ~70% of traffic.

tom: i'm available. can we carve route-level caps to relieve queue? prefer per-endpoint quota tweak rather than global shed.

anita: recommend temporary per-endpoint QPS cap and enable fallback routing for low-priority embed requests. Proposed: embeddings_route qps -> 600 (was 2000) for public endpoint; keep dedicated enterprise slices unchanged.

kyle: support notified customerA to pause bulk ingestion jobs; they acknowledged and are investigating.

rachel: executing mitigation now:
```bash
redwoodctl routes set-qps --route embeddings_route --qps 600 --scope endpoint --reason "live QPS surge - oncall mitigation"
```

deploy-bot: Change accepted. Applying per-endpoint QPS=600 to route id r-emb-342 across us-west-2 edges. Propagating config.

tom: enabling header-based fallback for non-critical embeddings: requests with X-Prefer-Fallback=1 will hit embeddings-fallback-v2. Will flip traffic gradually.

product_pm_jess: flagging that fallback model has slightly lower semantic recall; will communicate risk to impacted customers. Tracking in incident ticket.

rachel: handoff: handing active oncall to @tom for monitoring and follow-up. I'm updating the incident ticket with mitigation commands and customer list. :white_check_mark:

tom: taking over monitoring. immediate plan: keep per-endpoint cap in place, spin up +2 embedding worker nodes in us-west-2, watch tail latency and error rate.

tom: scaling infra:
```bash
infractl scale-pool --pool embeddings-main --add 2 --region us-west-2 --reason "oncall mitigation: absorb burst"
```

deploy-bot: Scale request queued and provision job started. Estimated ready ~6m.

rachel: customer impact summary for incident notes:
- customerA: high error spikes and >10s latency on some batches, support engaged.
- customerC: increased latency, some retries; asked to throttle.
- other customers: slight latency degradation (~1-2s) while queues drained.

kyle: support sent templated messages to affected accounts, opened PSR for customerA.

anita: post-mortem actions to consider:
- refine auto-shed to prefer per-endpoint caps over global sheds
- add per-customer token/burst limits on ingestion endpoints
- alerting: add spike detector for route-level QPS with early paging for >2x sustained minute

tom: update at +10m - queue depth trending down, p95 latency improving from 8s -> 2.5s, errors dropping. embeddings_route still under qps cap.

rachel: thanks team. leaving notes and switching status to monitoring-only. Will follow up on postmortem with timelines and action owners.

tom: plan to lift cap after infra finishes scale and stability holds for 15m. Will announce reversion here before action.

deploy-bot: Policy change (qps=600) will remain until manual revert or automated window expires.

tom: revert scheduled if stable at 6123457042.

rachel: closing handover. incident severity -> SEV3, no customer-facing outage beyond degraded embeddings. Logged in incidents board. :white_check_mark:

tom: noted. continuing to monitor. will post final summary once quotas reverted or escalated. :mag:
__notes: Single-string concatenation of Slack messages, chronological. No title field per agents.md.
